title: Students set new records for A-level grades in bumper year

paragraphs.en: Sixth-formers have basked in a summer of record-breaking exam results in academic and vocational subjects, allowing more than a quarter of a million 18-year-olds to go on to higher education.
paragraphs.zh: 六年级学生们在这个夏天沐浴在学术和职业类科目破纪录的考试成绩之中，使得超过 25 万名 18 岁的年轻人得以升入高等教育。

paragraphs.en: The proportion of students in England gaining the highest grade of A* in A-level subjects rose to 9.7%, up from 9.4% last year, setting a new record outside the pandemic era, when exams were scrapped.
paragraphs.zh: 英格兰学生在 A-level 科目中获得最高等级 A* 的比例升至 9.7%，高于去年的 9.4%，创下了疫情时代（当时考试被取消）之外的新纪录。

paragraphs.en: Northern Ireland was the best-performing country, with 30.7% of grades being As and A*s, followed by 29.6% in Wales and 28.7% in England.
paragraphs.zh: 北爱尔兰是成绩最好的地区，其成绩中有 30.7% 为 A 和 A*，其次是威尔士的 29.6% 和英格兰的 28.7%。

paragraphs.en: The A-level results followed last week’s improved results in Scotland, where the proportion of students awarded Highers and Advanced Highers qualifications rose above 2019 pre-pandemic levels, and a record 18,000 Scottish school-leavers gained higher education places.
paragraphs.zh: 紧随其后的是上周苏格兰公布的改善后的成绩——苏格兰获得高级（Highers）和高级进阶（Advanced Highers）资格的学生比例升至 2019 年疫情前水平之上，且有创纪录的 1.8 万名苏格兰离校生获得了高等教育名额。

paragraphs.en: The bumper crop of results means nearly 263,000 UK pupils have already been accepted on to university courses starting this autumn, driven in part by the rising number of 18-year-olds in the population.
paragraphs.zh: 丰收般的成绩意味着近 26.3 万名英国学生已被今年秋季开学的大学课程录取，这在部分程度上得益于人口中 18 岁青年数量的增加。

paragraphs.en: The results were boosted by improved results across the board, but mathematics in particular showed a strong improvement despite a rise in the number of candidates taking the subject.
paragraphs.zh: 各科目成绩普遍提升带动了整体结果，但数学尤其表现出强劲进步，尽管报考该科目的考生人数有所增加。

paragraphs.en: Among the most striking trends this year was the surge in popularity of economics, which jumped from 10th most popular position last year to fifth, with more than 47,000 exam entries.
paragraphs.zh: 今年最引人注目的趋势之一是经济学的人气飙升，它从去年的第十热门科目跃升至第五，报考人数超过 4.7 万。

paragraphs.en: Myles McGinley, the managing director of the Cambridge OCR exam board, speaking at a briefing by the Joint Council for Qualifications (JCQ), said: “The students getting their A-level results today were born around 2008.
paragraphs.zh: 剑桥 OCR 考试局的董事总经理迈尔斯·麦金利（Myles McGinley）在资格联合委员会（Joint Council for Qualifications, JCQ）的简报会上表示：“今天拿到 A-level 成绩的学生大约出生于 2008 年。”
